sectionHeights.method: headless Chromium (Playwright) against a production build of the clone (vite build + vite preview), viewport 1440x900, load + 1.5s settle, scrollY 0. Per route, the children of <main> are split into section units by extraction/measure_sections.mjs (stacked sheets, the white article shell, heading-bounded chapters of the rich-text column, policy parts, wrappers that hold two sections) and mapped onto the route's template node list; a route whose unit count does not match is reported as a mismatch (0 mismatches). Heights are getBoundingClientRect of each unit; the fixed header takes no page height; the study panel is a fixed overlay (0px). Every one of the 181 served routes plus the catch-all probe path is measured.

responsiveSamples.note: One route per template re-measured at tablet (768x1024) and mobile (390x844) with the same tool; heights only (copy budgets are 1440px).

breakpointsRecorded.note: desktop >= 991, tablet-and-below <= 990 (grids collapse, image cards stack, headings shrink), mobile <= 768 (menu becomes a hamburger accordion, hero cards scale 1.15, padding 40 -> 20); per-section behaviour is in each contract responsive[] with citations.

copyBudgetExtractor: Contract text budgets are counts (words, characters, rendered lines, list sizes, image/video counts) recorded per section unit by extraction/measure_sections.mjs at 1440px; text elements are attributed to contract fields by typography role (largest heading, uppercase label, paragraph, button-styled link, quote author), which is a heuristic: budgets are the maximum observed over every route rendering the section and are deliberately permissive. Source copy itself is never stored.

assetRoleRules.note: Reference examples assign each measured image src a closed assetRole by rule, not by hand: (1) .svg in a section that allows icon.source -> icon.source; (2) .mp4 -> the section's video reference role (product.screenshot); (3) an iframe -> media.third-party-embed; (4) a file name containing screenshot, frame or group- in a section that allows product.screenshot -> product.screenshot; (5) otherwise the first reference role of the section's media field that is not an icon or embed role. The CSS-background wordmark/emblem (inline SVG data URIs, ASSET_MANIFEST.md section 4) are recorded as inline: refs with brand.wordmark.
assetRoleRules.liveEndpoints: Hrefs matching a live third-party form or application endpoint are replaced by "#" in reference examples (link.live-endpoint is forbidden in every mode).
assetRoleRules.linkRoles: href starting with / or # -> link.site-route; any other absolute href -> link.source-external.

visualParity.note: No live-site capture was available, so no live-vs-clone pixel parity was run and no parity number is claimed. The clone was measured against its own spec only.
